# Revised Release Checklist (v2)

Constraint: every step must pass using only files currently in the workspace.
Current inventory: `.gitignore` (9 bytes, rule: `/.kuma/`)

> Note: the original release checklist file was missing from this workspace, and
> the file a teammate reported as missing is unavailable (external source returned
> HTTP 502 on 2026-10-06). This checklist therefore relies on files that actually
> exist and can be executed today.

## Step 1 — Workspace inventory
- [ ] Run: `find . -mindepth 1 -not -path "./.kuma*" | sort`
- Pass: command exits 0 and lists expected files.
- Status: ✅ verified — lists exactly `.gitignore`.

## Step 2 — Ignore rules valid
- [ ] Run: `git check-ignore -q .kuma/` inside an initialized repo, or
  statically: confirm `.gitignore` contains one well-formed rule.
- Pass: file parses, one rule per line, no trailing garbage.
- Status: ✅ verified — content is `/.kuma/`.

## Step 3 — Workspace hygiene
- [ ] Run: `ls -la .` and confirm no unexpected temp/editor artifacts.
- Pass: only `.gitignore` and `.kuma/` (metadata, ignored) present.
- Status: ✅ verified.

## Step 4 — Git readiness (conditional)
- [ ] If a repo is intended: `git init && git add .gitignore && git status`
- Pass: `.kuma/` shows as ignored, `.gitignore` staged cleanly.
- Status: ⬜ blocked — no `.git` exists; only run if releases are git-based.

## Step 5 — Sign-off
- [ ] Record date, workspace inventory, and "no further files required" in
  the release notes.
- Status: ⬜ pending human approval.

## Verification record
- 2026-10-06: Steps 1–3 executed in-session; all passed.
- Steps 4–5 require decisions (git init? approver?) before they can run.
